title: Marcos launches new Tupad programs to boost Filipino employment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday launched new employment programs aimed at helping Filipinos develop their skills, access job opportunities, and build sustainable livelihoods. Speaking at the 26th National Public Employment Service Office Congress in Cebu, Marcos introduced the Trabahong-Dagat, SkillPass, and Sagip-Trabaho programs as part of the Department of Labor and Employment’s seven flagship innovations under the Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged/Displaced Workers (Tupad) program.
